properties.NAME: MIDWAY (Mn. Terr)
properties.CHANGE: MIDWAY (Minnesota Territory, extinct) created by Minnesota Territory in present South Dakota from BROWN (Minn.); MIDWAY overlapped the western part of ROCK (now PIPESTONE, Minn.).
properties.CITATION: (Minn. Terr. Laws 1857, ext. sess., ch. 14, sec. 10/p. 68)
